text:
maria_cs: heads-up — Lumina onboarding hitting intermittent 429s during SDK init. customer sees a spike about 30s after creating first session.
ben_engineer: thanks. are these 429s API-level or our edge? any logs?
maria_cs: from their side they shared this snippet from our SDK logs: 
```
INFO init: post https://api.redwood.ai/v1/sessions 200
INFO telemetry: send {"X-Client-Telemetry":"v=1;env=staging;session=abcd1234"}
WARN request 429 POST /v1/generate (rate_limit)
```
maria_cs: they say it appears right after telemetry ping, ~1s after session create.
jess_sre: hmm — if telemetry pings are clustered it could look like a burst on our connector that trips edge ratecap. do we sample telemetry?
ben_engineer: we sample on the hosted side but SDK also sends a header per request. if many concurrent cold starts from Lumina's test suite, the header makes them all hit a hot shard in our edge LB.
lucas_infra: can you share request headers from a failing trace? we want to confirm shard key.
maria_cs: pasted anonymized headers from customer (timestamps removed): 
```
:method: POST
:authority: api.redwood.ai
:scheme: https
:accept: application/json
:content-type: application/json
:user-agent: lumina-sdk/0.9.1
:x-client-telemetry: v=1;env=staging;session=abcd1234
```
maria_cs: they run 20 parallel init calls during onboarding smoke test.
jess_sre: ok that explains it. quick mitigation: ask them to upgrade SDK patch (we can ship a 0.9.2 that batches telemetry or removes header on init), OR we can add an edge rule to ignore X-Client-Telemetry for shard hashing.
ben_engineer: prefer fixing server-side but also fine to push a targeted edge rule for this account while we release SDK. need to avoid global perf regress.
lucas_infra: staging edge rule looks safe if we scope by tenant header (x-tenant-id: lumina-123). I can deploy a temporary rule to treat x-client-telemetry as non-hash key for that tenant.
maria_cs: I'll ask Lumina if they can toggle a concurrency knob meanwhile. schedule call? they want quick turn.
ben_engineer: I'll draft a small SDK patch to stop sending the telemetry header during init and instead send it in background with jitter.
jess_sre: action items: 1) lucas deploy edge exception for lumina (scope by tenant) — ETA 45m; 2) ben prepare SDK patch & release 0.9.2 — ETA 2h; 3) maria coordinate with Lumina to throttle their smoke test and confirm fix — 30m call?
ci-bot: deploy job queued for edge-rule-change #PR-4823 by lucas_infra
maria_cs: booked 30m call at 22:00 UTC with Lumina. will follow up in thread with customer confirmation and logs. :thumbsup:
